THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

David Vanilla Cookies & Cream Hack

Half a pint of David Vanilla Bean + 3 crushed HighKey sandwich cookies = one large cookies-and-cream bowl. 175 cal / 16g protein. Three minutes, two ingredients, honest 8.5/10.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME3 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~175 cal | ~16g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Half the pint, not the whole pint. Full pint = 210 cal / 30g protein per current label; this hack is built for the 175/16 macro at half.

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • 1/2 pint David Vanilla Bean frozen dessert (~105 cal / 15g protein — half the current-label pint)
  • 3 HighKey Original Sandwich Cookies (31g / ~70 cal / 1g protein per 3 cookies on the current label)

Allergens: dairy, egg. Packaged labels vary — verify current David Vanilla Bean + HighKey Original Sandwich Cookies labels before publishing final allergen or diet tags. Formulations and facility statements drift. David Vanilla Bean contains milk and may contain soy, egg, peanut, and tree nuts. HighKey Original Sandwich Cookies contain egg and are made in a facility that also processes peanuts, tree nuts, and seeds.

You want a large cookies-and-cream dessert on a day when protein and calorie targets matter more than a perfect conventional ice cream experience. 3 minutes, 2 ingredients, no machine. Honest positioning: David Vanilla alone scored a 6/10, this hack scored an 8.5/10. Not the best-tasting protein ice cream — the value proposition is macro density plus the cookie fix.

Method

  1. 1.PORTION VANILLA BASE. Scoop half the David Vanilla Bean pint into a wide serving bowl. A kitchen scale helps you land at exactly 105 cal / 15g protein.
  2. 2.CRUSH COOKIES. Hand-crush 3 HighKey Original Sandwich Cookies directly over the bowl. Keep a mix of fine crumbs and larger crunchy pieces — the crunch is doing the flavor work.
  3. 3.FOLD + SERVE. Fold once or twice without crushing every piece. Serve immediately while the cookie pieces are still crisp — they soften fast in the ice cream.

Keys to success

  • Three cookies, hand-crushed. Not blended, not powdered — the crunch is the point.
  • Serve immediately. Cookie crunch is best in the first 60-90 seconds.

If something fails

Ice cream feels grainy: That's the base's texture — the cookie crunch is the fix. Add all 3 cookies and fold; don't try to smooth the vanilla out on its own.

Cookies soften too fast: The bowl sat too long between crush and eat. Assemble at the last second.

Too sweet: Reduce to 2 cookies (drops macros to ~150 cal / ~15g protein per current labels).

Not enough crunch: Use larger cookie chunks — break each cookie into quarters rather than crumbling fully.

Storage and reheating

Store: Assemble immediately before eating. Keep the pint frozen and the cookies sealed separately if pre-portioning; the cookies soften after they sit in the ice cream.

Reheat: N/A — eat immediately after crushing + folding.

Lasts: The pint keeps per the David label; the cookies keep per the HighKey label. The assembled bowl is best inside 2 minutes.

~175 cal | ~16g protein.

175 cal / 16g protein per one large bowl (half a David Vanilla Bean pint + 3 HighKey sandwich cookies).
